description: Call this after before_checkout says reaches_checkout is false, or when an agent got stuck at a store and you want the reason and the fix. Returns why (the saved blockers), fix (the store page's recorded fix, or "not recorded"), next_step and links to the full record. Example: why_blocked_and_fix({"store":"gymshark.com"}) → {"why":["…"],"fix":"…","next_step":"…"}. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

store.description: Store domain or URL, such as gymshark.com.

name: why_blocked_and_fix
title: Why blocked, and the fix
